# espalier_image (Resource)

An image pulled into the container runtime (`container image pull`). An image removed outside Terraform is pulled again. A tag that moves upstream is not followed: pin a digest (`name@sha256:…`) or change `name` to pull a new version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "espalier_image" "busybox" {
  name     = "busybox:1.37"
  platform = "linux/arm64"
}

# Pinned by digest, and kept when this configuration is destroyed.
resource "espalier_image" "registry" {
  name         = "ghcr.io/project-zot/zot@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  keep_locally = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image reference to pull, with a tag or digest. Short names resolve against the runtime's default registry (`registry.domain`, normally `docker.io`); no tag means `latest`.

### Optional

- `keep_locally` (Boolean) Keep the image in the runtime when the resource is destroyed, e.g. when other configurations use it too. Defaults to `false`.
- `platform` (String) Pull only this platform (`os/arch[/variant]`, e.g. `linux/arm64`). Pulls all platforms if not set.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest of the pulled image index or manifest.
- `id` (String) Fully qualified reference the runtime stores the image under, e.g. `docker.io/library/busybox:1.37` for `busybox:1.37`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Images are imported by the reference used in the configuration.
terraform import espalier_image.busybox busybox:1.37
```
